Description: shadcn/ui components are copied into your project not installed as dependency
Do: npx shadcn@latest add button
Don't: npm install @shadcn/ui
Code Good: npx shadcn@latest add button card dialog
Code Bad: npm install shadcn-ui // does not exist

Description: components.json controls aliases paths and style preferences
Do: Run npx shadcn@latest init to generate config
Don't: Manually create components.json with wrong paths
Code Good: npx shadcn@latest init // generates components.json, tailwind config, utils
Code Bad: Hand-writing components.json and missing cssVariables or aliases

Description: Path alias keeps imports clean and consistent
Do: Configure @ alias in tsconfig.json
Don't: Use relative paths to components

Description: CSS custom properties enable runtime theme switching
Do: Define colors in globals.css :root and .dark
Don't: Hardcode hex values in Tailwind classes

Description: shadcn uses HSL without the hsl() wrapper for Tailwind compatibility
Do: Define colors as space-separated HSL values
Don't: Use hex rgb or hsl() with parentheses

Description: Use class-based dark mode with next-themes
Do: next-themes ThemeProvider with class strategy
Don't: Media query dark mode or manual toggle without persistence

Description: Name colors by purpose not appearance
Do: Use primary secondary accent muted destructive
Don't: Name colors by their hue like blue red green

Description: Extend the default theme with brand colors
Do: Add new CSS variables and extend Tailwind config
Don't: Override built-in semantic colors for one-off uses

Description: shadcn components are designed for composition
Do: Use sub-components like CardHeader CardContent CardFooter
Don't: Flatten everything into a single component

Description: Components accept className for one-off overrides and variants for patterns
Do: Use buttonVariants or extend with cva
Don't: Modify the component source for every style change
Code Bad: Edit components/ui/button.tsx to add rounded-full to base styles

Description: Class Variance Authority creates type-safe variant APIs
Do: Define variants with cva for reusable patterns
Don't: Conditional className strings for variants
Code Good: const buttonVariants = cva('inline-flex items-center', { variants: { variant: { default: 'bg-primary', outline: 'border' } } })

Description: Add wrappers around shadcn components for project-specific behavior
Do: Create composed components that use shadcn primitives
Don't: Copy-paste and modify the source component
Code Bad: Copy button.tsx to submit-button.tsx and modify internals

Description: shadcn Form component integrates react-hook-form and zod validation
Do: FormField FormItem FormLabel FormControl FormMessage pattern
Don't: Build forms without validation or with custom validation

Description: FormMessage automatically shows zod validation errors
Do: Place FormMessage after FormControl in every FormItem
Don't: Show errors with custom state or alert boxes

Guideline: Use Select Combobox and DatePicker properly
Description: These complex inputs integrate with Form via FormControl
Do: Wrap in FormControl and pass field props
Don't: Use native select or build custom dropdowns

Description: Combine Table component with @tanstack/react-table
Do: DataTable with column defs sorting filtering pagination
Don't: Build tables with raw HTML table elements
Code Good: const table = useReactTable({ data, columns, getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel() })

Description: Card provides consistent padding borders and sections
Do: Card with CardHeader CardTitle CardDescription CardContent
Don't: Custom div with border and padding

Description: Badges show status labels and counts
Do: Badge with variant for different states
Don't: Colored spans or custom pill components

Description: Sonner integration for toast notifications
Do: useToast or toast() from sonner
Don't: Alert boxes or custom notification systems

Description: AlertDialog for destructive or important confirmations
Do: AlertDialog with AlertDialogAction and AlertDialogCancel
Don't: window.confirm or custom modal for confirmations

Description: Skeleton components for content placeholders
Do: Skeleton matching the shape of expected content
Don't: Spinners or blank space while loading

Description: Accessible navigation with dropdown menus
Do: NavigationMenu with NavigationMenuList and items
Don't: Custom nav with hover divs

Description: Shows current location in hierarchy
Do: Breadcrumb with BreadcrumbList BreadcrumbItem BreadcrumbLink
Don't: Manual breadcrumb with slashes and links

Description: Command component for searchable command menus (cmdk)
Do: CommandDialog with CommandInput CommandList CommandGroup
Don't: Custom search modal with manual filtering

Description: Tabs for organizing related content in same view
Do: Tabs with TabsList TabsTrigger TabsContent
Don't: Custom button group with conditional rendering

Description: Sheet slides in from edges - perfect for mobile nav
Do: Sheet with SheetTrigger and SheetContent
Don't: Dialog or fixed divs for mobile menus

Description: Popover for forms filters or info near trigger element
Do: Popover with PopoverTrigger and PopoverContent
Don't: Tooltip for interactive content or Dialog for small forms

Description: Separator creates accessible horizontal or vertical dividers
Do: Separator between content sections
Don't: Manual hr or border-top divs

Description: Combine typography components for page titles
Do: Use heading hierarchy with description text
Don't: Inconsistent heading styles across pages
Code Good:
Dashboard

Overview of your project
Code Bad: Random heading sizes and no description pattern

Description: Maintain consistent media proportions
Do: AspectRatio component for images and videos
Don't: Fixed width/height that breaks on resize
Code Good: <AspectRatio ratio={16 / 9}><Image src={img} fill alt='...' className='object-cover rounded-md' /></AspectRatio>
Code Bad: // breaks on mobile

Description: ScrollArea provides styled scrollbars across browsers
Do: ScrollArea for lists panels and sidebars
Don't: Browser default scrollbars or overflow-auto

Description: asChild passes accessibility props to your custom element
Do: Wrap custom elements with asChild on trigger components
Don't: Nest buttons inside buttons or lose accessibility

Description: Label component provides accessible form labeling
Do: Label with htmlFor matching input id
Don't: Placeholder-only inputs without labels
Code Bad: <Input placeholder='Email' /> // no label for screen readers

Guideline: Use VisuallyHidden for screen reader text
Description: Hide text visually but keep it for assistive technology
Do: sr-only class for icon-only buttons
Don't: Icon buttons without any text

Description: Animated expand/collapse with accessibility
Do: Collapsible with CollapsibleTrigger and CollapsibleContent
Don't: Manual height animation with state

Description: shadcn components expose data-state for CSS animations
Do: Animate based on data-[state=open] data-[state=closed]
Don't: JavaScript-driven show/hide animations

Guideline: Test all components in dark mode
Description: Every component should look correct in both themes
Do: Verify contrast and readability in dark mode
Don't: Only test in light mode then ship
Code Good: Use text-foreground bg-background consistently in custom components
Code Bad: Custom components with bg-white text-black // broken in dark mode

Guideline: Use foreground tokens for text on colored backgrounds
Description: Every color has a matching foreground token for accessible contrast
Do: text-primary-foreground on bg-primary
Don't: White text on colored backgrounds assuming contrast
Code Bad: <div className='bg-primary text-white'> // may not have contrast in all themes

Guideline: Use Drawer for mobile bottom sheets
Description: Drawer (vaul) for mobile-friendly bottom sheets
Do: Drawer on mobile Dialog on desktop with responsive switching
Don't: Dialog for everything including mobile
Code Bad: <Dialog> on mobile // hard to reach dismiss button

Description: ResizablePanelGroup for adjustable split views
Do: Resizable panels for IDE-like or dashboard layouts
Don't: Custom drag-to-resize implementations
